column3: detail: the detecting function (checked) or the reason no check can decide (outside: REASON)
whether a review stayed inside a merge's resolution is the reviewer's judgement of the diff; the head that is only a merge of main is decided by pinsonly and the flow (A29, A16)
whether a review lists every finding is judgement; reviews.missed counts the findings a later round adds, which is the nearest input a program reads

the harness adds attribution outside the body pitboss reads (owner ruling pitboss#282: footers are ignored, never managed), and an assignment or review request is an API event of the owner's account, not text pitboss is given
a pin file edited by a tool and one edited by hand have the same diff; bats pins-check and the relock are the verifiers (A29 is enforced), not text of ours
a shim for a weak engine is a design, not a string or a path
what an agent tells the owner is a conversation pitboss never receives
the coordinator's message is a conversation pitboss never receives
whether slots next was run before a dispatch is the agent's order of calls; the ledger records a dispatch, not the command before it

the task list is the harness's state, not a file pitboss reads
the checklist is the harness's state, not a file pitboss reads
checkin.overdue
how many times a worker ran pitboss nox is not recorded; the result of the pushed head is checked by hand-back-check
polling.waits
flake.unmarked_line
whether a secret is set is the repository settings' state, which the token pitboss runs with cannot read
ownerrepos.widened
outdated.lines
itempick.taken
whether an agent reports a bug to the coordinator is a conversation pitboss never receives
whether the orchestrator waits for the owner is a conversation pitboss never receives
what an agent says about having checked is conversation, and a sentence that says it is no test of whether it was done
whether the owner acted is a fact in his accounts and in his words, which pitboss is not given
whether an agent treats a ruling as approved is its behaviour; ruling post and the flow act on the comment (A2)
an artifact is any markdown the agent attaches to a question in a conversation pitboss never receives
which thread read a CI artifact is the harness's routing, which pitboss never receives
privacy of the owner is not a property of any text pitboss reads
the coordinator's instructions are conversation pitboss never receives
attaching a missing repository is the thread's action in the harness
a decision card is the harness's object; resolving it is an event pitboss is not told
whether a test is skipped to get green is judged against the failure it hides; test.fixme under a p0 ticket (T53) is the declared exception, settled by the ruling of ruleconflicts.tsv
